name: nested join with options
query: dataset = xdr_data | join type = left (dataset = xdr_data | filter true | limit 1) as sample sample._time = _time | fields _time

name: subquery in membership
query: dataset = xdr_data | filter action_process_image_name in (dataset = xdr_data | fields action_process_image_name)

name: multiple alter assignments
query: dataset = xdr_data | alter alpha = lowercase(action_process_image_name), beta = concat(alpha, to_string(42)) | fields alpha, beta

name: structural-only callback-like expression and JSON access
query: dataset = xdr_data | alter sample = arrayfilter(arraycreate(1, 2), "@element" -> active = true)

name: quoted pipe and comment markers
query: dataset = xdr_data | alter sample = "a|b // c /* d */" /* | future_stage() */ | limit 1

name: triple quote across lines
query:
dataset = xdr_data | alter sample = """first
| fake()
last""" | limit 1

name: numeric and boolean grouping
query: dataset = xdr_data | filter (1.2e-3 < 2 and (true or false))

name: data model entry
query: datamodel dataset = xdr_data | filter true | limit 1

name: keywords as member names
query: dataset = xdr_data | alter sample = payload -> filter | fields payload.lowercase, sample
